articles.title: Defence sector set for strong growth amid anticipated Budget boost
articles.summary: India's defence sector is poised for significant expansion due to anticipated major increases in government spending in the upcoming fiscal year (FY27). This development highlights a strategic focus on strengthening national security and modernizing military capabilities. Aspirants should recognize this trend as indicative of India's commitment to self-reliance and enhancing its defence preparedness, creating new opportunities within the sector.
